item.title: Former Prince Andrew arrested and held for hours on suspicion of misconduct over ties to Epstein
item.description: The former Prince Andrew was arrested and held for hours by British police Thursday on suspicion of misconduct in public office related to his links to Jeffrey Epstein, an extraordinary move in a country where authorities once sought to shield the royal family from embarrassment.
